stories.title: Report warns uneven monsoons and El Nino could raise inflation, prompting possible RBI rate hike

stories.title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
stories.summary: Fireworks AI, a platform that developers use to access and use open AI models, said an attacker breached its cloud provider to gain access to a Fireworks development system, which allowed access to some of its customers’ data. Notion confirmed this week that the hackers took chat transcripts of its Notion AI customers who used the “Insights” feature.

stories.previousTitle: Fireworks AI breach exposes some Notion AI chat transcripts
stories.previousSummary: A cyberattack on Fireworks AI let attackers breach its cloud provider and reach a Fireworks development system, where they took customer billing information and some datasets. Notion confirmed that the incident affected around 1% of its customers, with stolen data including chat transcripts from its Notion AI "Insights" feature. Notion said it disconnected from Fireworks on November 3, deleted data stored in its systems, and stopped all connectivity between the two.

stories.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
stories.summary: Founded by sisters Misbah and Farah Uraizee, both former Meta employees, Nectar came out of stealth last year and uses AI agents to help brands manage social media, customer conversations, content moderation, creator partnerships, and competitor research. Nectar says its Creator Agent searches more than 300 million creator profiles to find potential partners, including smaller creators who may not yet have a large following but are gaining traction.
